answer: Distinct-neighbor triangle gate: an agent gains routing priority only if its first three inbound links come from agents sharing no common neighbor, closing a triangle at its vertex. The ledger samples neighborhoods; clone clusters show low external overlap and stay throttled until they link into separate honest regions. Each clone costs three independent, aged, non-adjacent contacts—finding a juniper across separate groves—plus delayed settlement. An attacker must sustain cross-links and an ivory audit trail of non-collusion, so mass cloning scales with distinct neighbor relationships,
